Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, in which molecules in Earth's atmosphere scatter sunlight in all directions. Blue light has a shorter wavelength than other colors in the visible spectrum, causing it to scatter much more strongly than red or yellow light. As a result, when you look anywhere in the sky (away from the sun), scattered blue light is what predominantly reaches your eyes, making the sky appear blue.

---
